contracts.title: Semantic noun divisions are not grammatical gender or definiteness
contracts.inputs: Four supplied semantic Booleans: sharing prevention, equality across individuals, possession of an attribute, contextual dependence.
contracts.outputs: Six semantic QismIsm values: four universal classes and proper-name/pronoun particular classes.
contracts.proof_scope: General conditional classifier laws and finite enum exhaustiveness; no extraction from new words.
contracts.boundary: JinsMushtaq.jinsJamid is semantic genus, not masculine. QismIsm.sitta is not the six grammatical definite classes.

contracts.title: Definiteness is a declared annotation with named source categories
contracts.inputs: Frame and Attr=(tense, definiteness, person/gender/number, built), supplied by caller; d=0 indefinite, d=1 definite, d=9 inapplicable.
contracts.outputs: Checks annotation compatibility and finite witness sentences; maarif lists pronoun, proper name, demonstrative, relative, article-bearing, annexed.
contracts.proof_scope: wad_counts is a finite inventory-size check; tarif/tatabuq are closed examples; attrCode_inj proves encoding injectivity of supplied attributes.
contracts.boundary: Neither absence of article nor presence of tanwin proves indefinite. The article/annexation category requires its linguistic condition. slotAttrOK also assumes all imperfects unbuilt; that simplification is not transferable.

contracts.title: Fourteen pronoun readings preserve genuine gender ambiguity
contracts.inputs: Exact authored pronoun carrier/cell table; gender codes 0 masculine,1 feminine,2 shared; number0 singular,1 dual,2 plural.
contracts.outputs: Single or multiple feature readings; 8/14 unique by carriers,10/14 by cells; هما and أنتما retain both genders.
contracts.proof_scope: Closed table checks plus general la_dalla_tasturidd impossibility for any single-valued recovery of all rows; ihtizal requires equal list lengths and singleton readings.
contracts.boundary: Shared gender is not missing evidence. No general noun parser. muwafiqJumla returns true on unmatched tails; require independent exact inventory/length checks. laHukm accepts any supplied feature as a nonrestriction, not positive confirmation.

contracts.title: Gender and number agreement are conditional on supplied categories
contracts.inputs: Frame, feature annotations, and Ext carrying indefinite license, jamid flag, feminization mode and word kind.
contracts.outputs: Agreement check; overt broken-plural mode4 permits both verb genders; sound-plural mode5 follows the supplied singular-gender behavior; hidden subject retains full agreement.
contracts.proof_scope: Executable Boolean functions and closed conjunction witnesses musawwigh/tanith, not a theorem classifying all Arabic nouns.
contracts.boundary: Broken plural does not imply feminine lexical gender. The Ext category is not recovered from a suffix. Feminine sound-plural morphology and lexical masculine gender must remain distinct axes (e.g. طلحات in independent grammar scope).

contracts.title: Nominal ending rules require a prior lexical Bab
contracts.inputs: Declared Bab plus final cell and sometimes penultimate cell; Bab includes singular/broken analogue, dual, sound masculine/feminine plural, manqus, maqsur, etc.
contracts.outputs: Singleton, ambiguous case set or no judgment.
contracts.proof_scope: yayn_la_yufarriq and manqus_fatha_zahira hold for all prefixes and valid final states after fixing Bab; maqsur_la_yuayyin generally forbids singleton output.
contracts.boundary: No raw يا/ون/ات ending licenses Bab. manqus_fatha_zahira does not establish nounhood, inflection, necessary final ya or preceding kasra; those lexical premises need independent receipts. Nominal manqus must not be conflated with weak-final verb naqis.

contracts.title: Candidate intersection is transferable; cue activation is not automatic
contracts.inputs: Initial candidate list and predicates carrying labels; adjective gender is supplied for qaydTabaqNaat.
contracts.proof_scope: iqtiran_iff,tartib_la_yughayyir,qayd_la_yazid,tabaqat are general list-filter contracts. Gender/tense examples are finite.
contracts.boundary: qaydTaanith branches only on length/final ta; its narrow lexical/attachment assumptions live in comments, not in its argument type. Do not promote this to arbitrary noun gender reading. The new NABT contract must bind source, occurrence, reading, noun domain and activation support.

contracts.title: Numeral agreement and counted-noun form are supplied-input checks
contracts.inputs: naw=0 numeral name or1 agent/ordinal-like form (e.g. third), quantity q, numeral gender, counted singular gender; complete attachment frame for madudOK.
contracts.outputs: adadJins: same/opposite/shared-slot conditions; madudSura: 3–10 genitive plural,11–99 accusative singular,>=100 genitive singular; below3 no attached counted object in that function.
contracts.proof_scope: adad_shawahid is a large closed conjunction; no universal raw-text numeral extraction or real-entity counting theorem.
contracts.boundary: Do not copy unbounded arithmetic as grammar: q=0 uses same-gender branch; naw=1 bypasses quantity bounds; multiples of100 are generic; q=101 gives no gender judgment although madudSura returns a form. Shared-gender code2 for decades/hundreds is an explicit representation convention. Compound11–19 separate unit/ten genders are not represented by the single gender field.
contracts.transfer: A separately scoped cardinal-only law1..99,100,1000 with typed singular gender, separate unit/ten agreement, contextual cases for1/2, no entity or ordinal conclusions.

contracts.title: There are several unrelated meanings of numeric count
contracts.inputs: Dal.Adad: bounded cell lists; Nizam.Qiyas: evaluation-result records; SLGE.Count: explicitly supplied finite-state machine and accepted words.
contracts.outputs: Bijective encoding, evaluation counts/accuracy/coverage, or rank/unrank among formal strings.
contracts.proof_scope: General inversion/count composition/abstention invariance under each separate input specification.
contracts.boundary: No bridge to external entity cardinality, grammatical singular/dual/plural, ordinal adjectives, or spatial rank. Occurrence-ID counting is a new separately named computation, not a translation of Dal.Adad.

contracts.title: Weak-letter predicates are present; requested weak-position taxonomy is absent
contracts.inputs: Supplied carrier sequence/root. weak recognizes alif,ya,waw. SoundR excludes them. Mashru.jidhr only projects a length3 sequence with no weak carriers.
contracts.outputs: Phonetic licensing/generation/ranking, or supplied-root carrier projection.
contracts.proof_scope: wazn_any_root is general under SoundR, Spaced, equal length and bounded states. root3 counts machine-licensed shapes, not attested lexical roots.
contracts.boundary: Normalized search of all120 Lean files found no لفظ لفيف and only7 أجوف mentions, all explanatory comments in JisrDal. No operational mithal/ajwaf/naqis/lafif classifier found. W/Y position mask on a separately supplied canonical root would be new NABT law; keep masks3/7 explicitly residual and never attest a root from shape.

contracts.title: The integrated reader declares unresolved nominal-domain limits
contracts.inputs: Annotated Itar3 and normalized Qari cell stream; Qari records article/wasl flags from its bounded spelling procedure.
contracts.outputs: Estimated-ending permissibility and explicit domain gate; nonbuilt nouns in haddMuallan require grammatical number0.
contracts.proof_scope: No general proof that Unicode parsing or lexical feature activation is linguistically complete.
contracts.boundary: Utur comments53,425–430,561–562 explicitly leave dual/plural letter declension and manqus/maqsur lexical identification unresolved. Qari converts alif-maqsura, hamza seats, gemination and tanwin; no silent import into an exact-byte source-evidence profile.

contracts.title: Tawafuq is semantic-denotation compatibility, not grammatical agreement
contracts.inputs: Supplied Wad relation with witnesses, semantic predicate and entailment relation.
contracts.outputs: Exactly one denotation kind when realizable, and classification of mantuq/mafhum.
contracts.proof_scope: General logical uniqueness and no denotation without witnesses.
contracts.boundary: The filename cannot be cited as gender/number agreement implementation.

contracts.title: Semantic individuality and countability are separate input axes
contracts.inputs: Supplied semantic object with sharing-prevention Boolean, and counted/measured material tag with unit-ta Boolean.
contracts.proof_scope: kulli_la_bil_adad gives both universal and particular objects for any identical individual list; ifrad_madud unfolds a supplied unit-ta flag.
contracts.boundary: No grammatical singular/plural inference and no world-entity truth from lexical countability or number of recorded individuals.

ajwaf.text: المضمومة في المضارع والمفتوحة في الماضي على نمط (يَدْعُهُ ← يُدْعَهُ، غَرَّكَ ← غُرِّكَ)، والزمنُ المعلَن خطأً على نمطه (يَشْرَبَ ماضيًا ← يُشْرِبَ)، وصورةُ الأصل للأجوف لا تُميّزها الخلايا
وحرفُ العلّة الساكن (`illaSakin`: فيُرفض الأجوفُ والناقصُ اللذان فيهما قلبٌ، قال وباع: ثلاثةُ أوجهٍ L244 لم تُبنَ، ومعهما أَوْعَدَ وبَيَّنَ

في الجلسة (غيرُ مودَعة ولا معدودةٍ هنا) إلّا ما لا تُميّزه الخلايا مما أُعلن على عهدة المُدخِل (ومنه صورةُ الأصل للأجوف: وجدها المراجعُ في السادسة، وكانت تمرّ منذ ca5ed3c)، وإلّا آخرَ المضارع واوًا أو ياءً مضمومةً ظاهرًا
الزمن المعلَن (يَشْرَبَ ماضيًا ← يُشْرِبَ)، وصورةُ الأصل للأجوف (قَوَلَ ← قُوِلَ)؛ واللاحقةُ غيرُ المضمومة في المضارع وغيرُ المفتوحة في الماضي تُرفض بسببها، وما سوى ذلك خارجَ الأنماط. -/
والأداةُ لا تفرّق المجزومَ الأجوفَ من الناقص الذي كان يُخرج يُرَمِ من يَرْمِ.
معلَنًا ماضيًا ← يُشْرِبَ (الزمنُ على عهدة المُدخِل)؛ وصورةُ الأصل للأجوف: قَوَلَ ← قُوِلَ، بَيَعَ ← بُيِعَ، أَقْوَمَ ← أُقْوِمَ، يَقْوُلُ ← يُقْوَلُ (لا تُميّزها الخلايا
ممّا جاء على الأصل غيرَ معتلّ: أَعْوَزَ ← أُعْوِزَ — الكتاب س19976–19979؛ والأجوفُ بعد القلب بأوجهه الثلاثة L244 لم يُبنَ).

manqus.text: ويسمى منقوصا، والضمة والفتحة في نحو "يخشى"، / والضمة في نحو "يدعو ويقضي". وتظهر الفتحة في نحو "إن القاضي لن يقضي ولن / يدعو"»؛ المجهول
`hawamil_huruf`)، ولا حكمَ إن كانت الخليةُ الأخيرة 116 فما فوق (`hukm`؛ وما قبلها محصورٌ بحرفه). (١) **البابُ معلَن** `Bab`: المفردُ المنصرف، والفعلُ الصحيح، والمقصور، والمنقوص، والمضافُ
والمنقوصُ تظهر فتحتُه وحدَها (`manqus_fatha_zahira`). (٥) **الممنوع**: فتحتُه نصبٌ أو جرٌّ ولا كسرةَ له، ومع أل أو الإضافة يُجرّ بالكسرة
/-- **المنقوصُ تظهر فتحتُه وحدَها** (L93–94): ياءٌ مفتوحةٌ نصبٌ، وساكنةٌ الرفعُ والجرُّ مقدَّران، وغيرُهما لا حكم — بفكّ التعريف. -/
المثنّى والجموعُ بالحروف غيرُ مجسورة؛ والأسماءُ الستّة (القطر L78) والمنقوصُ والمقصور لا يُميَّزون بلا معجم: فجوةٌ معلَنة، تُقرأ منها منذ
ولا مضافٍ إليه ملحق وحده، لاحتمال المضاف إلى الياء «غلامي» (L92) — فالمنقوصُ بلا أل ولا مضافٍ إليه لا يُفرَّق منه بلا معجم، معلَن. أمّا
المعربة مفردةٌ (`n = 0`: الإعرابُ بالحركة على الخلية الأخيرة؛ المثنّى والجموعُ بالحروف غيرُ مجسورة — والأسماءُ الستّة (القطر L78) والمنقوصُ والمقصور
الاسم، ونصبًا في الاسم بلا أل ولا مضافٍ إليه ملحق وحده (لاحتمال «غلامي» L92؛ فالمنقوصُ بلا أل ولا مضافٍ إليه لا يُفرَّق منه بلا معجم،
والمقصورُ والمنقوصُ المنوَّنان («ذَهَبَ فَتًى»، «ذَهَبَ قَاضٍ») ممتنعان — يُقرأ ما قبل التنوين؛ والاسمُ بضميرٍ متّصل يُقرأ آخرُ خليّته — حركةُ
